observability.decision_trigger: mapped Polymarket best-bid-or-ask update that changes aligned midpoint
observability.event_time_target: next trusted observable SIG BBO update after decision time
observability.reason_one_second_rejected: SIG full-universe BBO is observed on a nominal 10-second REST refresh cadence

historical_discovery.role: retrospective discovery only; mappings and model frozen before predictive evaluation

features.normalization: training-fold-only median/IQR; zero-IQR features left unscaled

model.family: pooled linear ridge with mapping fixed effects
model.primary_prediction_metric: paired absolute-error reduction challenger versus baseline

bootstrap.method: moving block within contract then equal-contract aggregation

controls.wrong_contract: same category, different economic family; nearest training-only PM update-rate/spread/midpoint profile

execution.sig_depth_requirement: BBO price is primary markout surface; lack of stored SIG size is disclosed and prevents a strong size-capacity claim
execution.direction: sign of challenger forecasted subsequent SIG price-state change
execution.primary_exit: first valid executable SIG state at or after decision_time + 30 seconds

derived.transformation: sum of reviewed mutually exclusive Yes margin buckets
derived.synthetic_bid: sum of component executable bids at q
derived.synthetic_ask: sum of component executable asks at q

promotion.exact_price_discovery_supported: positive OOS incremental predictive information with bootstrap lower bound > 0, mandatory freshness/timestamp/null controls passed, and positive net executable markout meeting SME
promotion.exact_information_not_executable: predictive criterion passes but executable markout/depth-capacity criterion does not
promotion.derived_price_discovery_supported: DERIVED family independently passes its predictive and executable criteria
promotion.no_cross_venue_edge: adequate coverage but primary incremental predictive criterion fails
promotion.inconclusive: coverage, clock, capture or reconciliation limitations prevent the primary test
